en: Black-and-white street view of a European town or city, showing a cobblestone avenue lined with several‑storey masonry buildings with ornate facades and shopfronts with awnings. Trees line both sides of the street. People in early‑20th‑century clothing (long dresses, hats, coats) walk along the sidewalks and in the street. In the right background rises a tall, slender spire or tower with a domed base and finial. The scene has the appearance of a commercial main street or boulevard. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
